'''Harrison's Houndoom''' (Japanese: '''ハヅキのヘルガー''' ''Hazuki's Hellgar'') was {{Jo|Harrison}}'s first revealed {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, and appears to be one of his main Pokémon alongside {{TP|Harrison|Blaziken}}, often seen [[Walking Pokémon|walking beside its Trainer]].

==History==
[[File:Harrison and Houndoom.png|thumb|left|220px|Houndoom and Harrison]]
Houndoom debuted in ''[[EP265|Pop Goes The Sneasel]]'', where it was first seen walking beside its {{pkmn|Trainer}}. It listened to the story of {{an|Ho-Oh}}'s Sacred Flame and joined Harrison and the others when they went to retrieve it from a territorial {{TP|Harrison|Sneasel}}. It jumped in to battle Sneasel's {{p|Machop}} crony, repelling it with {{m|Flamethrower}}. On the second attempt, Houndoom fought alongside {{AP|Phanpy}} against the Machop and {{p|Machoke}}, using {{m|Headbutt}} to take down the latter, then catching it on its horns and throwing it over the hill, out of range of the battle with Sneasel. It appeared willing to battle Sneasel, but Harrison chose to use {{TP|Harrison|Blaziken}} instead.

During Harrison's battle with {{Ash}} in ''[[EP271|Playing with Fire!]]'', Houndoom came out as his fifth Pokémon to fight {{AP|Snorlax}}, who had already taken down {{p|Hypno}} and {{p|Steelix}} with little effort. Houndoom proved to be very powerful, using {{m|Counter}} to reflect {{m|Hyper Beam}} back onto it at double the strength, knocking out Snorlax in a single hit. 

Houndoom fought [[Ash's Bayleef]], where its [[Type#Type effectiveness|significant type advantage]] against her was made apparent as it roasted her {{m|Razor Leaf}} flurry with Flamethrower. However, Bayleef cunningly used {{m|Vine Whip}} to muzzle Houndoom and prevent it from using Flamethrower or Bite. Bayleef threw Houndoom onto the ground and {{m|Body Slam}}med it, taking it out of the match.

In ''[[EP272|Johto Photo Finish]]'', Houndoom battled and lost to [[Jon Dickson]]'s {{p|Rhyhorn}} after being rammed by the {{pkmn|category|Spikes Pokémon}}. As Harrison's final Pokémon, Houndoom's loss caused Harrison's elimination from the tournament.

==Personality and characteristics==

Houndoom appears to have a strong bond with Harrison, often being [[Walking Pokémon|seen walking beside its Trainer]]. It is a very strong and reliable Pokémon, being one of Harrison's main Pokémon along with {{TP|Harrison|Blaziken}}.
